title: Image Converter
summary: Batch image conversion tool with a premium drag-and-drop interface powered by ImageMagick.
highlights: Processes single or batch image format conversions.
Powered by ImageMagick running on a local Express API.
Modern, glassmorphic UI using vanilla CSS.
Automatically archives batch results into ZIP files.

services.label: Image Converter API
services.description: Runs the Express backend API and ImageMagick process.
